name: Razer lighting
author: M8SON
description: Control OpenRazer keyboards and mice from the Omarchy bar without the polychromatic tray applet. Brightness, every effect the device advertises (spectrum, static, breath, wave, reactive, ripple, starlight), and a full HSV colour wheel that applies instantly. A theme palette row picks up the running Omarchy theme, and an optional hook keeps the keyboard matched to the theme automatically. Mice get DPI and polling-rate controls; wireless devices show battery. Everything goes through openrazer-daemon over D-Bus, with no network access.

barWidget.description: Brightness, effect, and colour for OpenRazer devices.
